_comment: Sources for site/app/js/economy.js and tools/fetch-economy.mjs. Add each to site/app/js/sources.js (key: {name, url, license, role}) and to E in tools/build-references.py (key: (inText, fullAPA7)); 'RET + ' marks where the APA entry takes build-references.py's RET retrieval-date prefix. The existing 'censusgaz' entry ('U.S. Census Bureau, n.d.') should become 'U.S. Census Bureau, n.d.-a' (in-text and reference) now that censusacs is n.d.-b. Existing keys reused: censusgaz, osm, overpass.

sources.name: U.S. Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA) House Price Index (HPI), master file
sources.role: Quarterly house price index and its 1- and 5-year change for every U.S. state and metropolitan area.
apa: U.S. Federal Housing Finance Agency, n.d.
U.S. Federal Housing Finance Agency. (n.d.). *House Price Index datasets* [Data set]. RET + https://www.fhfa.gov/data/hpi

sources.name: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates, tables B25077 and B25064 (Census data API)
sources.role: Median value of owner-occupied homes and median gross rent in every U.S. county.
apa: U.S. Census Bureau, n.d.-b
U.S. Census Bureau. (n.d.-b). *American Community Survey 5-year estimates: Median value (B25077) and median gross rent (B25064)* [Data set]. RET + https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/acs
